manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
